title: reserve-request/1
description: Since 1.4.0. The optional body of POST /api/v1/answers/reserve: which batch versions the fetcher reads. It has no contract field, like ack-request/1. No body, an empty body, or an accept list without answers/2: the Portal replies answers/1 as before and the Client's updates wait. An accept list with answers/2: the reply is answers/2.

accept.description: The batch versions the fetcher reads, e.g. ["answers/1", "answers/2"].
